title: Shawn the Speedy Snail
mainIdea: People should use their talents to help others instead of thinking only about themselves.

pages.text: Shawn was the fastest and strongest snail in the ditch. He always reached the food and water first.

question.text: Who is the main character in the story?

pages.text: Because he was quick, Shawn ate and drank before the other snails could get any.

options: To get the food and water first

pages.text: Soon, the other snails became hungry and upset. They told Shawn to leave because he had been selfish.

options: He made the other snails hungry by being selfish

pages.text: Shawn moved to another ditch. Later, he returned and saw that his old friends were weak and starving.

options: His actions had hurt his friends

pages.text: Shawn carried his friends to the new ditch and brought them food. From then on, he used his speed to help others.

options: Shawn helped his friends and changed his behavior

elements.correct: To get all the food and water first
His selfishness left his friends hungry and upset
distractors: His friends took all of the food
His shell was too heavy to carry

elements.correct: He moved to a new ditch and later helped his friends
distractors: He stayed and kept the food
He raced the other snails again

elements.correct: He used his speed to help others instead of himself
distractors: He kept the food for himself only
He left the ditch and never returned
